The main takeaway from our work is that

bidirectional ELMo-like language representations can be pre trained from raw text without access to task specific annotations and then used as general purpose features in a variety of NLP applications.
deep bidirectional representations are powerful and can be learned from raw text without task specific supervision.

bidirectional ELMo like representations can be pre trained with a simple masked language modeling objective from raw text alone, which can be used to achieve state of the art performance on eleven natural language understanding tasks.
